notes.title: Version 1.1 – A World of Languages Awaits! 🌍✨
notes.notes:
[b]Update 1.1 Brings Multilingual Support to the Game![/b]
We're excited to announce that the game now supports 10 additional languages! Wherever you’re playing from, you can now enjoy the experience in your preferred language.

[b]🌍 New Languages Added:[/b]

[list]
[*] Norwegian 🇳🇴
[*] German 🇩🇪
[*] French 🇫🇷
[*] Spanish 🇪🇸
[*] Italian 🇮🇹
[*] Polish 🇵🇱
[*] Portuguese 🇵🇹
[*] Chinese (Simplified) 🇨🇳
[*] Japanese 🇯🇵
[*] Korean 🇰🇷
[*] Ukrainian 🇺🇦
[/list]

We hope this update makes the game more accessible and engaging for players around the globe. Thank you for your support – and as always, let us know how we can make the experience even better! 😊

notes.title: Outlaw Standoff is Live! 🤠💥
notes.notes:
The wait is over! Step into the dusty streets of the Wild West and test your reflexes in Outlaw Standoff, now available on Steam.

🌟 [b]Features at Launch:[/b]

[list]
[*] Fast-Paced Western Action: Quick-draw showdowns that get tougher with each round.
[*] Challenging Gameplay: Dodge bullets, aim true, and survive the outlaw’s wrath.
[*] Dynamic Visuals: Enjoy vibrant animations, immersive effects, and a western atmosphere.
[*] Steam Achievements & Cloud Saves: Prove your skills and keep your progress safe.
[/list]

🔥 [b]Ready to take on the fastest hands in the West?[/b]
Your journey starts here – but beware, the Outlaw doesn’t play fair.

🎯 Get it now and show the Outlaw who’s boss!
[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3266240/Outlaw_Standoff/]Purchase on Steam[/url]
